title: Fix Select.Item empty value prop validation error

requirements.summary: Update all Select.Item components in PropertyForm.tsx to use non-empty value props, replacing empty strings with meaningful values like 'none' or 'unspecified' to prevent validation errors while maintaining clearable Select functionality
acceptanceCriteria: All Select.Item components have non-empty string value props
No validation errors appear in the console regarding Select.Item values
Select components can still be cleared and show placeholders when needed
Form functionality for property type, furnishing status, and area selections remains unchanged

file_operations.description: Replace empty string value props in all Select.Item components with meaningful non-empty values. For property type Select.Items, use values like 'none' for the placeholder item. For furnishing status Select.Items, use 'none' or 'unspecified' for the placeholder. For area range Select.Items, use 'none' for the placeholder option. Ensure the form state handling and validation logic correctly processes these new non-empty placeholder values, treating them equivalently to cleared/unselected states. Update any conditional logic that checks for empty strings to also recognize the new placeholder values.

requirements.summary: Update all Select.Item components in PropertySearchBar.tsx to use non-empty value props, ensuring search filter logic correctly handles both cleared states and selected values with the new placeholder values
acceptanceCriteria: All Select.Item components in the search bar have non-empty string value props
Search filters work correctly with both cleared and selected states
No validation errors appear for Select.Item components
Filter placeholders display correctly when no selection is made

file_operations.description: Replace empty string value props in all Select.Item components with meaningful non-empty values such as 'none', 'any', or 'all'. Update the search filter logic to treat these new placeholder values as 'no filter applied' states. Ensure that when a Select is cleared or set to a placeholder value, the corresponding filter is not applied to the property search results. Verify that the location autocomplete, property type filter, furnishing status filter, area range filter, and price range filter all work correctly with the new non-empty placeholder values.
